blocking_findings.finding: The adapter constructor accepts an exact-model response with response_present=true even when the corrected gate is BLOCK, including provider refusal, and can synthesize the legacy PASS acknowledgement if called directly.

Aggregate retries subtract a provider ledger containing the local compatibility slot from delegate attempts containing the separate real recovery probe, relying on one-for-one cancellation between different slot identities.

important_nonblocking_findings: The local record has outcome local_corrected_gate_compatibility_acknowledgement and scientific=false, but copies provider response_id/model/token usage and lacks explicit response_origin/provider_contacted/provider_authored fields.
